thread:
ash: FYI: our JS SDK sample-app edge build is failing on Vercel with a weird ESM/CJS error.
ash: Error: Unexpected token 'export' in dist/index.cjs when running edge function.
ash: stack: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` — looks like a consumer expects ESM but got .cjs?
javier: Can you paste package.json exports + build output?
ash: Sure:
```json
{
  "main": "./dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs"
    }
  },
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
}
```
ash: But the published tarball only has index.cjs and index.cjs.map — no index.mjs or index.mjs.map.
olivia: Aha — so edge runtimes (Vercel/Cloudflare) prefer ESM. If the deploy uses the import path it'll try to load the .mjs and fall back incorrectly to .cjs, causing syntax mismatch in strict ESM mode.
caroline: How did the package end up without .mjs artifacts? CI changed last week to speed up builds; I think the edge build step was gated behind a matrix var that didn't run on the release runner.
ash: Also Sentry shows sourcemap lookups to ../src/index.ts but the published maps reference .cjs filenames, so the sourcemap consumer can't find the right mapping. Example in map header: "file":"index.cjs" but runtime requested index.mjs.
javier: That explains the missing types too — TS consumers importing as ESM got no proper .d.ts path in exports for conditional exports. We should add explicit exports for types.
olivia: Quick mitigation: republish a patch that includes both .mjs and .cjs artifacts and their .map files, and update package.json exports to include a `types` export so bundlers/tsc can resolve. e.g.
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": {"types": "./dist/index.d.mts", "default": "./dist/index.mjs"},
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  }
}
```
caroline: I'll re-run the release and include the missing dist files. Also adding a step in release.yml to verify artifact list: `ls dist | grep -E "(index\.mjs|index\.cjs|\.map|\.d\.ts)$"` so future releases fail if something's missing.
ash: Can we also add a unit check that validates package.json exports resolve to actual files before publishing? It bit us twice.
olivia: Yes — a tiny script that loads package.json and ensures every path exists in the tarball/build dir. We can run it as `npm run prepublishOnly` in the workflow.
javier: And add a test for edge runtime compatibility: run a tiny Node loader with `--input-type=module` to import the package entry and also `require()` it to verify both pathways. CI job should run both.
caroline: I'll open a PR with the release fix + prepublish script + CI guard. tagging @deploy-bot for the redeploy once merged.
deploy-bot: release:redeploy triggered for v0.15.3-patch. See https://ci/repo/1234/builds/5678
ash: After republish, sample-app on Vercel worked. Verified sourcemaps in Sentry now map to src files correctly. :tada:
olivia: Follow-up: we should document ESM/CJS expectations for customers and add a checklist in our SDK publishing guide (edge-friendly artifacts, maps, and types).
caroline: Adding to DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md in the SDK repo after the PR.
javier: Great. Thanks all.
